title: Trade-in Bonus $2000 on Eligible Tesla Model 3 and Y
body:
Deal: Trade-in Bonus $2000 on Eligible Tesla Model 3 and Y

[excite] buy a cheap used car under $2,000, then trade in?
[mavis30551] Do they exist?
I think most would be exempt as they dont take Repairable write offs etc
[xrailgun] i mean if you want to absolutely maximize the "value" from this, yeah, somehow.
but otherwise a $2000 bonus on a $6,000-10,000 car (if they value it fairly) is pretty decent too.
[Royale with cheese] They don't value fairly. Low balling by 10k
[arcticmonkey] Yes, I've found Tesla to be horrible at what they will pay for your car. $2k doesn't make much difference.
They also want a mint for their used stock
[vorsprung] Yeah they’re offering $26k for my 2022 Model 3 which I could probably get $34k for tomorrow (currently trying for more).
[eddyah] I read I think on whirlpool maybe about how they had someone do the trade-in valued at 25K for their car and then upon inspection they dropped the price by another 10K
They could have sold it privately for around 30K but for whatever reason went ahead with the trade in
[dan76n] Good deal if you have an old car with issues you want to get rid of.
[yht] Usually when you take up trade in offer, they will not allow you to negotiate with the new car prices.
[eciuj] New Tesla prices aren't negotiable anyway.
[Royale with cheese] Demos get listed as slightly cheaper on the website with fixed prices.
[sim36] This isn't a deal.
Sales at tesla will under quote trade-in value offered by 2K, add 2K and hey presto, there's your "bonus" offer. Can guarantee you you're not going to be happy with the amount they offer you on a trade in as well. Notorious low ballers.
[BatmanAU] 100%, they gave me a rubbish figure for their own vehicle, BYD beat there trade value by $5k.. And no i didnt go BYD, i was just curious
[Ijasah saya palsu] Correct, I ended up selling privately and then bought the Y L.
[maverickjohn] On the contrary for me they gave me best trade in value from all the sellers
[kipps] 100%, this was my experience. I had the same car quoted before and after trade in promos, mere weeks apart, and the discount was negated.
[TEER3X] The wife said she'll leave me if I ever bought a Tesla.
Off to the nearest dealership.
[BatmanAU] Funny when you get a trade in value from Tesla for your Tesla, your Tesla in their eyes is worth stuff all.
[FuRyZ] Tesla's trade in offers are notoriously poor. Even with a $2000 bonus, you will almost certainly get more selling it just about anywhere else.
Even a CarSales instant offer will almost certainly be better.
[seijai] Tesla only offering me $26k for my 2022 Model Y RWD, with only 42k mileage. Pathetic
[Crono] Do you think they would take a 2004 corolla with hail damage?
[No Client List] a Toyota….you'd get $12,000 for it on Marketplace
(based on T's new prices)
[nowayho] is the standard base model with ocean blue paint available in aus
[Oh Boy] They under quote anyway, but the only positive thing is you don't need to drop off your car until the new one is ready for collection, which isn't that common
[t0087669] How do I know my trade in car is eligible for offer?
[I like GoodDeals] Trade-in valuations at Tesla are a joke. They offer 50% less than the market value.
The sales rep mentioned this service is for people who just don't want to take the hassle of getting the RWC, selling a car via carsales, negotiating with people, meeting tyre kickers etc. They were upfront about selling the car privately is beneficial. Selling the car privately will save you > $2000
[Wiadro] why would anyone want a tesla
everyone these days has one
dont be a sheep
[mickeyjuiceman] In Ballarat, I'm seeing way more BYDs than Teslas these days
[Buddy195] As BYD sell EV’s starting less than half the price of a Tesla hardly surprising. I see way more Nissan than BMW’s, as it’s a price thing.
